guidance_v2.description: The court has postponed your case without setting a new date.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: No action needed immediately; check back periodically or ask your lawyer when a new date is likely.

guidance_v2.case_stage: Case adjourned for want of time
guidance_v2.description: The court did not have enough time to hear your case today, so it has been pushed to a later date.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Note the new hearing date and attend as scheduled.

guidance_v2.case_stage: Matter adjourned at the request of counsel
guidance_v2.description: Your own or the other side's lawyer requested more time, so the hearing was postponed.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Ask your lawyer why the adjournment was requested and confirm the new date.

guidance_v2.case_stage: Case adjourned due to non-availability of judge
guidance_v2.description: The assigned judge was unavailable, so the hearing was postponed for administrative reasons.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: No action needed; a new date will be set automatically.

guidance_v2.description: Your case is scheduled for lawyers to present their arguments to the judge.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Confirm with your lawyer that they are prepared and attend the hearing if required.

guidance_v2.description: The court will decide whether to formally accept your case for hearing.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Ensure your lawyer has filed all required documents before this date.

guidance_v2.description: The court intends to conclude your case at this hearing.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Attend or ensure your lawyer attends; this is an important hearing.

guidance_v2.description: The court has started hearing your case but has not finished; it will continue on a future date.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Attend the next hearing date; the same judge will typically continue.

guidance_v2.case_stage: Case coming up for final hearing
guidance_v2.description: A specific date has been set for the concluding hearing of your case.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Prepare with your lawyer and attend on the scheduled date.

guidance_v2.description: Your case is placed in a general category for minor or procedural matters, not the main hearing.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: No major preparation needed, but confirm with your lawyer what specifically will be addressed.

guidance_v2.description: Your case will be handled by a court administrative officer rather than a judge, usually for procedural matters.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Ensure required documents/formalities are ready; this is usually not a hearing on merits.

guidance_v2.case_stage: Matter fixed for hearing on merits
guidance_v2.description: The court will examine the actual facts and arguments of your case, not just procedure.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: This is a substantive hearing; prepare thoroughly with your lawyer.

guidance_v2.case_stage: Interim order granted, next date for compliance
guidance_v2.description: The court has issued a temporary order, and there is a deadline for someone to follow it.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Read the order with your lawyer and ensure any required action is completed before the compliance date.

guidance_v2.description: The judge has heard the case and will announce a decision at a later date.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: No action needed; wait for the order to be pronounced.

guidance_v2.description: The court has finished hearing arguments and will deliver its final decision later.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: No action needed; your lawyer will inform you once the judgment is announced.

guidance_v2.description: Your case has been concluded by the court. This does not necessarily mean you lost.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Ask your lawyer for a copy of the final order and what it means for you specifically.

guidance_v2.description: Your case was dismissed because a required party did not appear in court.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Contact your lawyer immediately - you may be able to file an application to restore the case.

guidance_v2.case_stage: Matter dismissed in default of appearance
guidance_v2.description: Similar to above - your case was dismissed because you or your representative did not appear.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Contact your lawyer immediately about restoring the case.

guidance_v2.description: The court has issued a final order and the case file is now closed.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Obtain a copy of the order from your lawyer for your records.

guidance_v2.description: A decision was made with only one side present, because the other side did not appear.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: If this was decided against you, consult your lawyer urgently about your options to challenge it.

guidance_v2.description: The court has refused to pause the action you wanted paused.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Discuss alternative options with your lawyer promptly, especially if a deadline is approaching.

guidance_v2.case_stage: Stay granted till next date of hearing
guidance_v2.description: The court has temporarily paused an action until the next hearing.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Note the next hearing date; the pause only lasts until then.

guidance_v2.description: The court has refused to grant temporary relief you requested.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Consult your lawyer about next options and any time-sensitive consequences.

guidance_v2.description: The court has formally informed the other party about your case and asked them to respond.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: No action needed from you right now.

guidance_v2.description: The court's attempt to formally notify the other party failed - they could not be reached.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: You may need to provide an updated address for the other party. Consult your lawyer.

guidance_v2.description: The court is still waiting for confirmation that the other party received their summons.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: No action needed; the case will proceed once service is confirmed.

guidance_v2.case_stage: Notice issued, returnable in four weeks
guidance_v2.description: A notice has been sent, with a four-week deadline for a response.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: No immediate action; the case will progress once the response period ends.

guidance_v2.case_stage: Fresh notice ordered to be issued
guidance_v2.description: The court has ordered a new notice to be sent, often because the earlier attempt failed.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: No action needed; wait for confirmation of successful notice.

guidance_v2.description: Your case has been moved to a different judge or courtroom, often for administrative reasons.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Confirm the new courtroom/judge and hearing date with your lawyer or the court registry.

guidance_v2.case_stage: Case transferred for want of jurisdiction
guidance_v2.description: The original court decided it does not have the legal authority to hear this case, and moved it elsewhere.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Confirm the new court with your lawyer; this may cause a delay.

guidance_v2.description: The case was taken back and filed again, often to correct an error or change something procedural.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Ask your lawyer why this happened and confirm the new case details.

guidance_v2.description: Your case has been moved to a district-level court, often for jurisdictional reasons.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Confirm new court location and any new case number with your lawyer.

guidance_v2.case_stage: Application for condonation of delay pending
guidance_v2.description: Someone has asked the court to excuse a missed deadline, and the court hasn't decided yet.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Wait for the court's decision; your lawyer will inform you once decided.

guidance_v2.description: The formal document authorizing a lawyer to represent someone has not yet been submitted.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: If this concerns your own representation, ensure your lawyer files it promptly.

guidance_v2.description: The other party has not yet submitted their formal written response to your case.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: No action needed from you; the court will typically set a deadline for them.

guidance_v2.case_stage: Rejoinder to be filed within two weeks
guidance_v2.description: A written reply to the other party's statement is due within two weeks.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: If this applies to you, ensure your lawyer files it before the deadline.

guidance_v2.description: The court is waiting for a formal written response from one of the parties.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: No action needed unless this is your responsibility - confirm with your lawyer.

guidance_v2.description: A higher court has sent the case back to be reconsidered.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Discuss with your lawyer what the reconsideration will involve.

guidance_v2.description: A previously closed or dismissed case has been reopened.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Confirm the next steps and hearing date with your lawyer.

guidance_v2.description: A higher court has agreed to formally review your case again.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Discuss with your lawyer what documents or preparation are needed for the appeal hearing.

guidance_v2.description: The appeal was closed because the person who filed it chose to withdraw it.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Confirm with your lawyer why the appeal was withdrawn and what it means going forward.

guidance_v2.description: A request asking the court to review its own earlier decision is still being considered.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: No immediate action; wait for the court's decision.

guidance_v2.description: A request asking a higher court to correct an error in a lower court's decision has been concluded.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Ask your lawyer for the outcome and what it means for your case.

guidance_v2.description: The court has ruled that this second-level appeal cannot legally proceed as filed.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Consult your lawyer about any remaining legal options.

guidance_v2.description: The court has approved release from custody, usually with certain conditions attached.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Review the bail conditions carefully with your lawyer and ensure they are followed exactly.

guidance_v2.description: The court has denied a request for protection from arrest in advance.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Consult your lawyer immediately about alternative legal options.

guidance_v2.case_stage: Accused released on bail with conditions
guidance_v2.description: Release has been granted, but specific conditions must be followed.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Make sure every condition is understood and strictly followed to avoid bail being revoked.

guidance_v2.description: The court has extended the period someone remains in custody during investigation or trial.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: Consult your lawyer promptly about the reasons and any options.

guidance_v2.description: A request to formally enforce a court's earlier decision (e.g. recover money owed) is still being processed.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: No immediate action needed; check status periodically or ask your lawyer for updates.

guidance_v2.case_stage: Compliance report to be filed within thirty days
guidance_v2.description: Someone is required to submit proof to the court that they followed an earlier order, within 30 days.
guidance_v2.suggested_action: If this applies to you, make sure the required report is filed before the deadline to avoid penalties.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only and does not constitute legal advice. Always consult a qualified lawyer for decisions specific to your case.
